trailhead.label: Beside Malga Vallazza on the Passo Valles road, the board’s start

cautions: The start is on the Passo Valles road (SP81): keep your dog on a short lead by the road.
Open saddle at about 2,300 m with no shelter: turn back if storms build.
Old First World War trenches beside the tarns: keep your dog out of them.
No water point is listed on this walk: carry enough for you and your dog.
Follow local signs, lead rules and temporary closures.

emergency.note: Call the European emergency number when urgent help is required. Connectivity is not guaranteed.

textIt.Open saddle at about 2,300 m with no she: Sella aperta a circa 2.300 m senza riparo: torna indietro se si formano temporali.
textIt.Old First World War trenches beside the: Vecchie trincee della Grande Guerra accanto ai laghetti: tieni il cane fuori.
